description: Stage a change to the owner's FAQs, which assistants quote as the business's own answers. action add (question up to 300 characters, answer up to 2000), update (faq_id from get_owner_content with a new question and/or answer) or remove (faq_id). Returns intent, expires_at and consequence quoting the exact text; confirm_update_faq applies it after approval. Requires company:write; the account selects the business.
name: update_faq
title: Prepare an FAQ change
